summary: A WHO publication's web annexes, L1 or L2, held as data in the knowledge graph rather than as the files WHO attaches to the publication: a DAK's core data dictionary workbook as JSON (`dak-data-dictionary/v1`, loaded on demand by the IG site's annex view), and the declared mapping from its generic personas to the swimlanes of its business-process figures (`dak-swimlanes/v1`). Every node says which publication it is an annex of (`annexOf`: a library entry when one is held, else the parent's IRIS handle), what the publication calls it (`label`, e.g. "Web Annex A"), its own IRIS handle only when WHO gave it a record (`iris`), and the document-kind section it serves (`section`, e.g. `dak#core-data-elements` or `l1#annexes`).

avatar.reads: a page with a folded corner and rows — a publication's annex, held as data

rationale: Owner, 2026-10-24 (option A, 08:32Z): widen `dak-annex` into one `web-annex` kind for L1 and L2 annexes alike; and "web annex is a special WHO thing. associated to publications. not sure if they get own full IRIS record or not" — so the kind stays smart-base's, every node names its parent publication, and its own IRIS handle is optional. The two families keep their names: what changed is the kind, not the formats. smart-base's own kind, NOT families added to fhir-harness's kinds: a web annex is a WHO concept, and fhir-harness may know nothing about WHO (`check:fhir-harness-exclusions`). An IG site places an annex through fhir-harness's generic `ig-annex` page hook, whose directory holds this kind's directory nested inside it. The registry joins a validator only onto a family its kind lists, so the files need a kind that lists them: this one. `derived`: each file is written by a smart-base script from the publication's own source (the workbook; the personas page and the process figures plus a declaration of aliases) and regenerated, never edited by hand except the swimlane declaration's aliases, which the script reads and does not write. Judged by `check:web-annexes` (formerly `check:dak-annexes`, 2026-10-11).
title: WHO web annexes
